study: Validation-only robustness of the frozen baseline CNN to synthetic audio degradations

model.why: seed-study recommendation: baseline_cnn (no convincing winner; simplest within one pooled seed SD); baseline_cnn_v3 is its frozen seed-42 configuration

definitions.applied_to: 16 kHz cycle waveform after frozen trimming/resampling, before frozen Log-Mel (PRIMARY_CONFIG, 50-2000 Hz) and frozen train-band normalization
definitions.gaussian_noise: white Gaussian, full 0-8 kHz band; SNR from DC-free mean-square powers; noise mean-removed and rescaled so the realized SNR is exact
definitions.lowpass: Blackman-windowed sinc FIR, 1025 taps, unit DC gain, centered (zero phase), cutoff = -6 dB point
definitions.temporal_dropout: 20 ms blocks; round-half-up(fraction x n_blocks) random blocks set to 0
definitions.randomness: torch.Generator per cycle, seed = sha256(base_seed|family|recording|cycle_index), base_seed 42; shared within a family

report_rules.reference_scale: pooled within-architecture seed SD of validation macro F1 from the seed study (reports/runs/seed_study/summary.json); changes smaller than this are of the same size as retraining with another seed
report_rules.negligible: a family is 'negligible' if |macro-F1 change vs clean| < reference_scale at every level
report_rules.collapse: otherwise, walking clean -> mild -> severe, a family shows a 'collapse threshold' at the level reached by its largest single-step macro-F1 drop if that step is >= 0.05 and >= twice the sum of all its other positive step drops; otherwise 'gradual'
report_rules.hurts_most: lowest macro F1 among degraded conditions; per family, the change at the most severe level
report_rules.tolerated_best: family with the smallest mean |macro-F1 change| over its levels
report_rules.class_fails_first: per family, the first level (mild -> severe) at which any class's F1 drops by >= 0.05 vs clean; the class with the largest drop there
report_rules.prediction_collapse: a condition 'collapses predictions' if >= 80% of cycles are predicted as one class
report_rules.uncertainty: patient-level bootstrap (compare_runs.patient_bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0) of the paired macro-F1 difference vs clean; supporting only, not used by the rules

rules: test split never loaded or evaluated
frozen preprocessing, normalization statistics, split, labels and checkpoint unchanged
no conditions added, removed or tuned based on results
